rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.03 reflects an extremely compressed, near-stalled price action in the $26.75–26.79 band, making any meaningful risk/reward structurally unattractive — a stop wide enough to avoid noise would require accepting a loss disproportionate to any realistic target. Price is mid-range (44.9%) with no catalytic news and session VWAP ($28.56) far overhead offering no near-term magnetic pull, so neither a bounce nor continuation thesis carries sufficient mechanical conviction. With today already in a realized loss and no identifiable directional trigger, the highest-quality decision is to preserve capital and wait for a cleaner setup.
